correctness.rationale: An exact rational variable transformation reduces the published necessary-and-sufficient stability criterion to Φ=a(8p−1)+b(4p−1)≥0. It implies strict p>1/8 and the quadratic root lower bound with b≥ℓ. Both piecewise equality designs obey the cap, the relaxation interval and Φ≥0, and are unique. The physical-phase coefficient follows from the actual eigenvalue expansion via log-series cancellation. The standalone rational/decimal verifier completed successfully; finite checks are supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The zero-frequency nonconserved collision multiplier cap is a natural quantitative kinetic-relaxation design constraint. The exact two-branch Pareto law supplies a global best possible long-wavelength dispersion magnitude, a sharp crossover from equal to unequal relaxation, unique realizable optimal schemes, and an unattainable 1/24 dispersion floor when damping is allowed to degenerate. This is more than an isolated negative check or a routine parameter substitution. It does not purport to control full Fourier damping or total solver error.
